subject: Exec clearance request: NovoCare bioinformatics pilot — export/KYC review + discount
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: NovoCare pilot — export controls + KYC flag / exec clearance request

Hi Laura / Rishi,

Quick summary: NovoCare (Barcelona) is evaluating a 12-month pilot of Redwood Dedicated for an internal bioinformatics inference workload. They requested a 25% first-year discount and an exception on our standard data residency clause — they need EU-only hosting and want Redwood to agree to limited on-prem-style access for a small subset of model outputs for regulatory validation.

Why I’m escalating: preliminary screening returned a potential export-control "dual-use" flag because the customer deals with certain chemical assay models. Their procurement sent initial KYC docs (attached) but Legal asked we get exec clearance before committing to a non-standard commercial term.

Attachments: NovoCare_SOW_v1.pdf; NovoCare_KYC_Packet.zip

Asks: 1) Can Deal Desk/legal confirm whether this requires an export control exception? 2) If green, can we approve a 25% discount + EU-only Dedicated deployment as a go-to-market pilot?

I’ve included the HubSpot link in case you want to review the deal timeline: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7824

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

--
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovoCare pilot — export controls + KYC flag / exec clearance request

Jasmine — thanks for the note and the attachments. A few immediate items:

- I see references in the SOW to assay model outputs that could be used for regulated chemical synthesis screening. That triggers an export-control review for dual-use; we need a formal screening report (end-user and end-use).
- The KYC packet is incomplete (missing beneficial ownership and current board list).
- Discount request (25%) and the proposed contractual carveouts will require exec signoff from Head of Partnerships / CRO.

Can you ask NovoCare to: 1) confirm no ties to sanctioned entities and produce a scanned certificate of incorporation showing current ownership; 2) provide the end-use statement specifically clarifying no intent to use our models for chemical synthesis or supply chain manipulation? If they can’t do that, we should not approve the carveouts.

Cc'ing Vivek (secops) to run sanctions / export screening. Vivek — if you can provide an initial risk tier by EOD tomorrow that would be helpful.

-Laura

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novocare.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: purchasing@novocare.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:37:00 +0100
Subject: Re: NovoCare pilot — export controls + KYC flag / exec clearance request

Hi Jasmine / Laura,

Thanks for the clarification. Quick responses inline below and attaching corporate documents: NovoCare_corp_docs.pdf

- Headquarters: Barcelona, Spain. No subsidiaries in sanctioned jurisdictions.
- Beneficial ownership: founders (listed in attached doc) and two EU VCs.
- End use: the pilot is for internal analysis of patient genomics anonymized datasets for diagnostic research. We explicitly will not use Redwood outputs for chemical synthesis.

I hope this helps — happy to arrange a conference call with our CTO and legal counsel to walk through the redlines. Procurement would like to finalize terms this month.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
General Counsel | NovoCare Therapeutics
marta.ruiz@novocare.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 08:55:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: NovoCare pilot — exec clearance request / commercial ask

Looping execs — this is time-sensitive. Procurement aims to sign by month-end. Summary for decision:

- Commercial ask: 25% first-year discount; 12-month Dedicated (EU-only) pilot; limited contractual carveouts around output inspection for regulatory validation.
- Compliance: initial docs attached; external counsel confirms no sanctions matches but Legal needs an export-control signoff.

Request: Vivek, can you provide a succinct recommendation (green/yellow/red) and any required mitigations? If green with mitigations, can we approve a 20% discount and proceed with the proposed Dedicated pilot while Legal prepares a tailored addendum?

Links: HubSpot DEAL-7824: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7824
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/ret/0AB2A1C2

Rishi
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovoCare pilot — exec clearance request / commercial ask

Team — reviewed the materials and ran sanctions/export screening against global watchlists and end-user screening. Findings and recommendation: 

- Screening: No matches on primary sanctions lists (OFAC, EU, UN). Beneficial owners are EU VCs/founders per NovoCare_corp_docs.pdf. No red flags in corporate registry checks.
- End-use assessment: The SOW references diagnostic model evaluation; NovoCare has confirmed (in writing) there is no intent to use outputs to design or synthesize chemical agents.

Recommendation (conditional approval):
- Risk tier: Low-medium with mitigation.
- Commercial concession: Approve a 20% first-year discount (not 25%).
- Deployment: Approve EU-only Dedicated pilot but require added contractual controls — a binding export-control clause, audit rights, and a representation that outputs will not be used for chemical synthesis.
- Pre-reqs: 1) Complete beneficial ownership disclosure filed in our portal; 2) SOC2 Type II attestation or equivalent (or an agreed timeline to provide within 60 days).

Please proceed to draft an addendum incorporating the export-verbiage and the mitigations above. Legal (Laura) — if you confirm the addendum language, I will greenlight the revised discount.

Vivek
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
